question: The Ebony, Mahogany, Cinchona etc. are trees found in which type of forests in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical Evergreen Forests**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tropical Evergreen Forests** are characterized by dense and multi-layered vegetation.
 
• These forests are also known as **rainforests** due to their constant high levels of rainfall.
 
• Trees in these forests, such as **Ebony**, **Mahogany**, and **Cinchona**, are known for their **hardwood** and are highly valuable.
 
• The climate in these forests is typically **hot and humid** throughout the year.
 
• They are mainly found in regions with an annual rainfall of over **200 cm**.
 
• These forests are home to a wide variety of **fauna**, including many **endangered species**.
 
• In India, tropical evergreen forests are primarily located in the **Western Ghats**, **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**, and the **Northeastern states**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tropical Deciduous Forests**__

 __
 
• Also known as **monsoon forests**, these forests shed their leaves during the dry season.
 
• They are found in regions with **moderate rainfall** (70-200 cm annually).
 
• Common tree species include **Teak**, **Sandalwood**, and **Sal**.
 
 
 
• **Thorny Forests**__
 __
 
• These forests are adapted to **arid and semi-arid regions**.
 
• Common vegetation includes **cacti**, **acacias**, and **euphorbias**.
 
• They are mainly found in parts of **Rajasthan**, **Gujarat**, and the **Deccan Plateau**.
 
 
 
• **Mangrove Forests**__
 
 
• Mangrove forests are found in **coastal regions**, particularly in **estuaries and deltas**.
 
• They are adapted to saline and brackish water conditions.
 
• Commonly found along the **Sundarbans** in West Bengal.
